notablePrerequisites: You have at least three cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gnawing Vermin, adding {B}.
Gnawing Vermin dies, triggering its second ability, causing target creature you don't control to get -1/-1 until end of turn.
Cast Gnawing Vermin from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Gnawing Vermin enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability twice, causing you to mill four cards.
Repeat.
